title: The Cargo Freight Maximum Payload
statement:
You are assigned to put some amount of boxes onto one truck. You are given a 2D array boxTypes, where boxTypes[i] = [numberOfBoxes_i, numberOfUnitsPerBox_i].
You are also given truckSize, which is the maximum number of boxes that can be put on the truck. You can choose any boxes to put on the truck as long as the total number of boxes does not exceed truckSize.

Return the maximum total number of units that can be put on the truck.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers N and truckSize.
Next N lines: Two space-separated integers numberOfBoxes and numberOfUnitsPerBox.

sampleCases.explanation: Take 1 box of 3 units + 2 boxes of 2 units + 1 box of 1 unit -> total units = 8.
